reviews.comment: As a history major, Dr. Hernandez is one of the best at Texas A&M. If you love Mexican-American, Texas, or boarder land history take her! Her expectations are clear, she wants you to succeed, and she is very knowledgeable in her work! Her lecture style makes the history easy to follow and is very helpful with test prep.

This was one of the easiest classes I have taken so far. You do not have to show up to class; I went the first day and before our first essay was due to get general rules for writing her essays. As long as you are good at writing essays and know enough about History you'll be fine. Easy A class as long as you don't fail any of the exams/essays.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall this class wasnt too bad, the only grades are 3 exams as well as 2 written analysis over some readings. As long as you pay attention in class you should do well. Asking questions and using the SI to your advantage will help you out as well

A simple class, based on 3 exams and two papers this semester. The exams make up for the majority of the grade and are made by the TA's. However, lectures were boring, and not really interesting. Could be an easy A for a history major.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: this class was super easy, I didn't even show up to lecture at all after the first test. during class all she does is talk, but all of the slides and reading material are accessible online. all tests are take home and online. there were 2 papers but they were super easy
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class was not enjoyable. The tests are too difficult BUT online and not proctored. She is really caring and would offer extra credit at times however, she rambles during lectures and is really hard to follow. I would say that if you put a good amount of effort in you can get an A, but I don't feel like I really learned anything.

No busy work. Lectures are boring and hard to hear because she doesn't use a mic. 3 exams, 2 essays, no final. Exams are online, not proctored, but are extremely hard. I got high B's on all of them. Essays brought up my grade. Extra credit. Exam questions from the textbook readings but reading the textbook barely improved my scores.

She was very nice, and cared about her students. However, she talks very slowly, is hard to hear, and tends to ramble a lot. If you have difficulty focusing, I would not recommend taking this class with her.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is very nice and will help you understand the material if you ask. She doesn't have a ton of assignments and doesn't grade harshly. I recommend going to class as she gives a lot of background information on the topic, showing she is very interested in what she teaches. The end-of-term paper isn't too hard, would take it again.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very lecture heavy course, however I wouldn't say you HAVE to attend class...I missed quite a few & still did well, & there were a few opportunities for extra credit by attending some sort of history department event & writing a quick recap of it. There were 4 graded papers, which had to meet a pretty hefty word count, & were harshly graded IMO.

She is a sweet lady who lets you re-do assignments & her class isnt too hard. Her quizzes can be difficult if you do not go to class. She is an easy grader for our 8 page research paper. The tests were not too bad but she does make a lot of type-o mistakes which is annoying. She is the easiest history teacher & has the highest class GPA!
She is a very kind professor! Make sure to read the articles and do the readings.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: TAKE THIS CLASS. Honestly did 0 of the readings & am making an A. Tests & quizzes r easy if you pay attention. There's very few assignments, which is nice. Final paper is not too difficult, & she is not a hard grader. She is well educated and you will actually learn a lot. The border trip is also SO fun, even if it sounds horrible. Highly recommend

Here's how you pass. GO TO CLASS, get familiar with her, be her friend... she's super sweet and enjoys knowing you. KNOW WHAT SHE'S LECTURING/BASIC UNDERSTANDING IN THE READING. She sometimes gives pop quizzes over the reading but she usually gives you a heads up. You will have a big paper to write but she's fair and wants to help! TAKE THIS CLASS.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Hernandez is a gem. She is smart, empowering, and cares about her students' success. There was only 2 exams, a presentation, and an 8-page research paper that was not all that bad. I suggest you meet her during her office hours, so she can know you at first name basis. I would definitely take her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Inspirational--BEWARE OF POP QUIZZES--Would take again

reviews.comment: Prof. Hernandez is a great professor for 280. Her classes all deal with borderlands, and isn't really that interesting but she makes it easy. She is very helpful and gives you plenty of time to complete everything. The class has one 20 page paper and a 3 page book review and that is all. Not hard at all.

Dr. Hernandez is AMAZING! An absolute gem who knows what she is talking about. Normally, she lectures every class period and provided tips for our 20 page paper and gave great feedback to polish the papers. Few books to give more tips over citations and such and another for information she believed important of MexAm history to use for the paper.
